lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement consists of approximately four to five vertical columns of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters, with three to four nodes per column clearly resolvable in the mid-flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of high-intensity spots to create a discernible grid-like anchor node system across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges run across the dorsal-lateral flank, characterized by a distinct pixel intensity gradient with light-reflective upper margins and shadowed ventral boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, dark-pixel silhouettes are visible attached to the ventral-lateral area and the base of the pectoral fin.
